policy_note: Owner outputs remain authoritative for their own calculations. This corpus composes exact receipts only; it does not re-run routing, continuity, measurement, calibration, consent or source-authentication implementations. Potential access is never actual service use. Unknown denominators and missing consent remain explicit.

semantics.restoration: exact City restoration bridge output; no recomputation
semantics.potential_access: exact CityMorph group result; accessible capacity is potential only
semantics.operational_measurement: exact in-use metric result plus owner input metadata binding
semantics.realized_service_use: separate source-owned delivery receipt with frame, unit, scope and time-window match
semantics.resident_experience: consented survey evidence, separate from meter/service outputs
semantics.zero_demand: verified zero is distinct from unknown and never divided by
